observations: Photo 0: Nikon DSLR camera with a 70-300mm lens, placed on a box labeled 'McSteve'. The camera body is black with visible wear, especially on the grip area. The lens has 'Nikon AF-S DX' and '70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED' engraved on it.

Photo 1: Same camera and lens from a slightly different angle, showing the top of the camera with mode dial and shutter button. The lens barrel has 'Nikon DX' and '70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED' clearly visible. The camera body shows some dust and minor scuffs.

Photo 2: Side view of the camera, showing the grip area with significant black discoloration and wear, especially near the shutter button. The lens barrel has 'Nikon AF-S DX' and '70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED' engraved. The camera body appears to be in used condition with visible scratches and dirt.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on or in operation. No proof of functionality is provided. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light, or a video showing the lens being focused and the image quality.

risks.risk: Camera body may have internal damage or moisture damage (e.g., from being stored in water or high humidity)

Close-up photo of the front lens element under bright light.
